title: Viceroy And Governor Generals Of India
definition: The administrative heads of British India, evolving from the Governor of Bengal (1773) to the Governor-General of India (1833) and finally the Viceroy (1858), representing the British Crown's authority.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is a perennial favorite in UPSC Prelims (chronology, policy matching) and Mains (administrative evolution, impact of colonial policies on Indian nationalism).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Viceroy And Governor Generals Of India.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
